account: Mohamed Abdel-Aty and Shengxuan Ding of the University of Central Florida's Smart and Safe Transportation Lab assembled 2,100 automated-vehicle crash records. They came from the California DMV and NHTSA's Standing General Order databases (1,099 SAE Level 4 ADS, 1,001 Level 2 ADAS). They added 35,113 human-driven-vehicle crashes from California's SWITRS and fitted a matched case-control logistic regression. Compared with human-driven vehicles, the odds of an ADS crash in rain were 0.335 times, and most pre-crash movements reduced crash odds. But the odds of an ADS crash at dawn or dusk were 5.250 times and in turning maneuvers 1.988 times those of a human-driven vehicle. The authors attribute the advantages to object detection, precision control and decision-making, and the disadvantages to sensor adaptation to changing light and limited situational awareness. The paper was received 30 Sep 2023, accepted 2 May 2024 and published 18 Jun 2024, the date given. The analysis does not attribute vehicles to specific developers, so no individual maker is credited. The Europe PMC full text is among the sources.

fields.account: Mohamed Abdel-Aty and Shengxuan Ding of the University of Central Florida's Smart and Safe Transportation Lab assembled 2,100 automated-vehicle crash records. They came from the California DMV and NHTSA's Standing General Order databases (1,099 SAE Level 4 ADS, 1,001 Level 2 ADAS). They added 35,113 human-driven-vehicle crashes from California's SWITRS and fitted a matched case-control logistic regression. Compared with human-driven vehicles, the odds of an ADS crash in rain were 0.335 times, and most pre-crash movements reduced crash odds. But the odds of an ADS crash at dawn or dusk were 5.250 times and in turning maneuvers 1.988 times those of a human-driven vehicle. The authors attribute the advantages to object detection, precision control and decision-making, and the disadvantages to sensor adaptation to changing light and limited situational awareness. The paper was received 30 Sep 2023, accepted 2 May 2024 and published 18 Jun 2024, the date given. The analysis does not attribute vehicles to specific developers, so no individual maker is credited. The Europe PMC full text is among the sources.
